## Description

Applies Graph Attention Networks over asset correlation graphs to enforce eigenvalue spectral clipping and regularization directly on the Riemannian manifold of Symmetric Positive Definite covariance matrices.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional portfolio optimization, noisy covariance matrix estimation, risk-parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Risk-Parity Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental relational adjacency graphs.

## Caveats

Combines graph attention mechanisms with non-Euclidean Riemannian manifold logarithmic/exponential maps.
